phase.title: Lite Combined Phases 2-5 - Threat and Domain Model

required: Accepted Source Intelligence identity verified at segment entry
Current Domain Applicability Matrix and registry
conditional: Source Intelligence rebind after material identity change
Evidence that changes an applicability trigger

steps.instruction: Map trust boundaries, authority transitions, upgrade paths, callbacks, dependencies and protected assets; create stable HYP records for material attack sequences.
Evaluate all domain triggers. Treat UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE as triggered, bind activated domains to Phase-4 work, and reevaluate only when evidence changes a trigger fact.
Update the live graph and obligation ledger with material hypotheses and specialist obligations, then continue directly to Phase 4 without a separate report or duplicate seal.

sealingCriteria: Every material threat has a stable hypothesis and route
All specialist domains have evidence-bound classifications
No separate Phase-3 report or duplicate global seal is filed

recoveryRoutes.route: Repair only the incomplete combined-segment record
Classify invalidation and rebind affected evidence
